motive.zhHans: 江户川柯南随后推断，犯人不可能是 Chono 或 Sakamaki，因为他们在抬起长矛时会发出声响，并会被 Nishitsu 听到。他的动机是他身患重病的女儿，治疗需要花费巨额金钱。Subaru 透露，他的那个托盘的价值足以支付这笔费用，因为另外两个托盘不是赝品，而是习作。漫画与动画的差异 主条目：漫画与动画的差异列表 由于这三集改编自四章漫画，出现了一些漫画中没有的额外场景：回忆《替身演员》中的 Makoto Kyogoku，当时真纯询问了兰和园子关于灰原的事。
motive.en: Conan then deduces that there is no way the culprit is Chono or Sakamaki because they would’ve made a sound when they lifted the spear and would have been heard by Nishitsu. His motive was his daughter who has a serious illness that costs a huge amount of money to treat. Subaru reveals his tray would have been enough to cover that cost because the other two trays aren't fakes, but studies. Manga to anime changes Main article: List of differences between the manga and anime Because these three epiosdes were adapted from four manga chapters, there are some additional scenes that were not in the manga: Flashback to Makoto Kyogoku the Understudy, where Sera asked Ran and Sonoko about Haibara.

method.zhHans: Subaru 透露，他的那个托盘的价值足以支付这笔费用，因为另外两个托盘不是赝品，而是习作。油漆可能是 Nishitsu 用溶剂去除油漆时剥落的。玛丽说那是来自 Tsutomu 的东西，后来 Shuichi 也捡到并经常使用。
method.en: Subaru reveals his tray would have been enough to cover that cost because the other two trays aren't fakes, but studies. The paint might have peeled off when Nishitsu used a solvent to remove the paint. Mary says that it comes from Tsutomu, which later Shuichi also picked up and often used.

evidence.zhHans: 他觉得会被发现，于是用相近颜色的油画颜料涂满了整个盘子，但最终还是被发现并遭到了严厉的训斥。在动画中，助听器是由鉴识人员发现的，随后由千叶把它带到犯罪现场。在漫画中，助听器仍在犯罪现场，是高木踩到它之后才发现的。
evidence.en: Feeling that it would be discovered, he painted the entire dish with similar colored oil paint, but in the end, he got found out and got a severe scolding. In the anime, the hearing aid is discovered by the forensics, then it is brought to the crime scene by Chiba. In the manga, the hearing aid was still on the crime scene, it was discovered by Takagi after he stepped on it.

resolution.zhHans: 世良推断，血迹和鹤的喙不可能出现在同一个位置，除非它们位于盘子的顶部。在阿笠博士翻转托盘之前，血迹指向东北方，而鹤的喙指向西北方。托盘被翻转之后，鹤的喙最终就会指向东北方。结果犯人就是 Motoyuki Tojima。江户川柯南随后推断，犯人不可能是 Chono 或 Sakamaki，因为他们在抬起长矛时会发出声响，并会被 Nishitsu 听到。Tojima 随即说他的助听器出了故障，所以他不可能听到。然而，在此之前他不可能知道助听器的事，除非 Nishitsu 告诉了他，这意味着凶案发生时 Tojima 和 Nishitsu 在一起。
resolution.en: Sera deduces that there is no way the blood and the crane's beak could be at the same spot unless it is at the top of the dish. Before Agasa flipped the tray, the blood was pointing northeast, while the crane's beak was pointing northwest. When it was flipped, then the crane's beak would end up pointing northeast. As a result the culprit is Motoyuki Tojima. Conan then deduces that there is no way the culprit is Chono or Sakamaki because they would’ve made a sound when they lifted the spear and would have been heard by Nishitsu. Tojima then says that his hearing aid had malfunctioned, so he couldn't have heard it. However, there was no way for him to know about the hearing aid before, unless Nishitsu told him, which means Tojima was with Nishitsu when the murder happened.
